summary.text: Andy Shamblin is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates for District 59, which he has represented since December 2022, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is an educator and minister who previously served on a city council.

paragraphs.text: Andy Shamblin was born in Charleston, West Virginia, and graduated from Nitro High School in 2009.
He earned a bachelor's degree from West Virginia State University in 2014 and a graduate degree from Marshall University in 2018.
His career experience includes working as an educator and minister, and he also served as a city council member.
Ballotpedia lists him as affiliated with the Nitro Development Authority and Peoples Federal Credit Union.
Shamblin took office in the House of Delegates on December 1, 2022, succeeding Republican Ken Reed, and advanced from the Republican primary on May 12, 2026.
